in_sanskrit.name: Ktm
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Kali's name
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ktm एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Krishna Tara Maha’ meaning ‘Great Goddess Kali, who is an embodiment of Krishna’s mercy and protection’. Kali is a form of the goddess Shakti, revered for her fierce form and her protective role in Hindu mythology.
